oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_81 (WHO Drug Information Vol.33 No.1, 2019), English chemical name for 'tofersen'; corroborated by FDA QALSODY label section 11 DESCRIPTION (sources/cns/QALSODY_tofersen_label_dailymed.htm) and by US10385341 'Certain Compositions' item 1 (ISIS 666853, SEQ ID NO: 725)
oligos.notes: TRIPLE-CONFIRMED. (1) Parsed from INN List 81 longhand name; formula C230H317N72O123P19S15 -> P19 = 19 internucleotide linkages = 20 nt, S15 = 15 PS. (2) QALSODY label: '20-base residue (20-mer) 5-10-5 MOE gapmer mixed backbone... of the nineteen internucleotide linkages, fifteen are phosphorothioate diesters, and four are phosphate diesters', same formula. (3) US10385341 states ISIS 666853 = 5'-CAGGATACATTTCTACAGCT-3' (SEQ ID NO: 725), 5-10-5 MOE, PO at linkages 2-3/4-5/16-17/18-19, notation mCes Aeo Ges Geo Aes Tds Ads mCds Ads Tds Tds Tds mCds Tds Ads mCeo Aes Geo mCes Te. DISCREPANCY TO RECONCILE: existing kidney-table row OLG017 stores 'CAGGATACATTTCTACAGCU' (trailing U) and backbone_chemistry=full_PS, ps_count=19; all three documents here say the 3' residue is 2'-MOE-5-methyluridine (thymine base, written T by both the patent and the label) and that the backbone is mixed PS/PO with 15 PS. OLG017 should be corrected.

oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_74 (WHO Drug Information Vol.29 No.3, 2015), English chemical name for 'nusinersen'; corroborated by DailyMed SPINRAZA SPL setid dd70cd5f-b0fc-4ba4-a5ea-89a34778bd94 section 11 DESCRIPTION
oligos.notes: Uniformly 2'-MOE, no DNA gap (splice-switching, targets SMN2 intron 7 ISS-N1). INN List 74 formula C234H340N61O128P17S17 -> P17 = 18 nt, S17 = 17 PS = fully phosphorothioate. SPINRAZA label gives the sodium salt as C234H323N61O128P17S17Na17, which is the same molecule (17 H replaced by 17 Na). Sequence reproduces existing row OLG004 character-for-character - used as a parser-validation target.

oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_83 (WHO Drug Information Vol.34 No.1, 2020), English chemical name for 'tominersen'
oligos.notes: Non-allele-selective HTT lowering. INN List 83 formula C230H319N74O122P19S13 -> P19 = 19 internucleotide linkages = 20 nt (self-check passed), S13 = 13 PS, matching the 13 'P-thio' residues parsed from the chemical name; the remaining 6 linkages are phosphodiester. Phase 3 GENERATION HD1 (NCT03761849, Hoffmann-La Roche, COMPLETED); phase 2 GENERATION HD2 (NCT05686551) ongoing. NCT05686551 exclusion criteria name tominersen as an 'HTT lowering therapy', confirming the target gene.

oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_85 (WHO Drug Information Vol.35 No.1, 2021), English chemical name for 'eplontersen'; corroborated by DailyMed WAINUA SPL setid d7dcb847-71dd-4fff-82d0-d43a465fc096 section 11 DESCRIPTION
oligos.notes: NON-CNS COMPARATOR (subcutaneous, GalNAc-conjugated, hepatocyte targeted) - included per task as a design comparator; its measurements should carry is_cns_specific=FALSE. oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_88 (WHO Drug Information Vol.36 No.3, 2022), English chemical name for 'zilganersen'
oligos.notes: NOTE THE ASYMMETRIC WING: parsed sugar pattern is 6 x 2'-MOE / 10 x DNA / 4 x 2'-MOE, i.e. 6-10-4, NOT the usual 5-10-5. oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_87 (WHO Drug Information Vol.36 No.1, 2022), English chemical name for 'zorevunersen'
oligos.notes: TANGO (targeted augmentation of nuclear gene output) ASO - uniformly 2'-MOE with NO DNA gap, so it is non-RNase-H, exactly the nusinersen architecture. INN List 87 formula C234H334N71O124P17S17 -> P17 = 18 nt (self-check passed), S17 = 17 PS = fully phosphorothioate. Intrathecal. oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_94 (WHO Drug Information Vol.39 No.3, 2025), English chemical name for 'diranersen'
oligos.notes: SHORT 18-mer GAPMER with an 8-nucleotide DNA gap (5-8-5), not the usual 20-mer 5-10-5. INN List 94 formula C210H300N53O116P17S15 -> P17 = 17 internucleotide linkages = 18 nt (self-check passed), S15 = 15 PS matching the parsed count; 2 phosphodiester linkages. Intrathecal. BIIB080=diranersen and the MAPT target from NCT05399888 detailed description ('designed to target microtubule-associated protein tau (MAPT) messenger ribonucleic acid'); phase 2, Biogen. Also appears as Proposed INN List 132.

oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_91 (WHO Drug Information Vol.38 No.1, 2024), English chemical name for 'mivelsiran'
oligos.notes: DUPLEX. sequence_5to3 holds the ANTISENSE/GUIDE strand (23 nt) per the dataset convention; SENSE strand (21 nt) = GGCUACGAAAAUCCAACCUAA. ps_count 8 = 4 PS on the sense strand + 4 on the antisense strand; all other linkages phosphodiester. Delivered intrathecally and CNS-targeted by a 2'-O-hexadecyl (C16) lipid anchor at sense position 6 - NOT GalNAc, hence conjugate=lipid. Antisense position 7 is a glycol-nucleic-acid (GNA) thymine (INN: '1-de-beta-D-ribofuranosyl-1-[(2S)-2,3-dihydroxypropyl]-5-methyluridylyl', flanked by non-canonical (5'->2') and (3'->3') linkages) and antisense position 1 carries a 5'-(E)-vinylphosphonate on a 2'-O-methyl uridine. VALIDATION: the INN List 91 entry gives NO molecular formula (it uses a structural diagram instead), so the length could not be confirmed by phosphorus count. It was instead confirmed two other ways - (a) the guide strand is the exact reverse complement of the sense strand over the 21-nt core, treating T as equivalent to U for base pairing (the two T positions are the DNA thymidine and the GNA thymine); (b) the base-pairing schematic printed in the same INN entry independently spells the sense strand GGCUACGAAAAUCCAACCUA... and the antisense ...CCGAUGCUUTUAGG..., both matching this parse, and its own legend uses T for those residues. The WHO source text contains a typographical error at one linkage ('P-thiouridylyl5'->3')', missing an opening parenthesis) which the parser tolerates. ALN-APP identity/target from NCT05231785 (study id ALN-APP-001) and NCT06393712 (ALN-APP-002, CSF sAPPalpha/sAPPbeta endpoints); phase 2, Alnylam.

oligos.design_source: WHO_Recommended_INN_List_92 (WHO Drug Information Vol.38 No.3, 2024), English chemical name for 'elsunersen'

extraction_notes:
LANE: sequences (identity/design only). measurements[] intentionally empty.

METHOD. Reused METHODOLOGY.md section 4 path 4 (WHO INN nomenclature derivation). WHO Recommended INN Lists 70-95 and Proposed INN Lists 108-135 were downloaded from cdn.who.int, text-extracted with PyMuPDF, and searched by INN name. Each entry's English longhand chemical name was parsed deterministically: split on linkage tokens, one nucleobase per residue, with a hard error if any residue token yields zero or more than one base (this is what catches PDF line-break damage rather than silently mis-parsing it). The 12 lists actually used are saved in sources/cns/ as WHO_INN_RecommendedList<NN>_<year>_<vol>_<compounds>.pdf so the derivation is reproducible.

DIRECTION HANDLING (the dangerous failure mode). A strand written with (3'->5') linkages is listed 5'->3' and is emitted as-is; a strand written with (5'->3') linkages is listed 3'->5' and is REVERSED on output. Non-canonical (5'->2') and (3'->3') linkages, which flank glycol-nucleic-acid residues, are excluded from the direction vote.

PARSER VALIDATION (done BEFORE any new sequence was written). The parser reproduced five sequences already in data/oligos.csv character-for-character: inotersen OLG001 = TCTTGGTTACATGAAATCCC (INN List 77), nusinersen OLG004 = TCACTTTCATAATGCTGG (List 74), givosiran OLG003 guide = UAAGAUGAGACACUCUUUCUGGU (List 76), inclisiran OLG007 guide = ACAAAAGCAAAACAGGUCUAGAA (List 76), and vutrisiran OLG022 guide = UCUUGGUUACAUGAAAUCCCAUC (List 81). The two single strands test the (3'->5') path; the three duplex guides test the (5'->3') reverse path; vutrisiran additionally tests the GNA-residue handling later needed for mivelsiran. All five passed.

SELF-CHECKS ON EVERY NEW SEQUENCE. For all 9 single-strand ASOs the published molecular formula's phosphorus count equals (length - 1), and the sulfur count equals the number of P-thio residues counted by the parser - both matched in every case, so length and PS count are independently confirmed rather than asserted. Eplontersen is P20 for a 20-mer because of the extra GalNAc conjugate phosphate. Mivelsiran's INN entry carries no molecular formula, so it was instead checked by reverse-complementarity of guide vs sense over the 21-nt core and against the base-pairing schematic printed in the same entry (see its notes).

LETTER CONVENTION. Nucleobase letters, not sugar letters: thymine (whether as 2'-deoxythymidine or as 2'-MOE-5-methyluridine) = T, uracil = U, cytosine (including 5-methylcytosine) = C. This is the convention that reproduces inotersen and nusinersen exactly, and it is independently corroborated by two non-INN documents that spell tofersen's 3'-terminal MOE-5-methyluridine as T (US10385341 and, for eplontersen's equivalent residues, the WAINUA label). Sugar chemistry is carried in sugar_modifications/gapmer_design instead of being encoded in letter case, so no case information is lost.

CONFLICT FOUND IN THE EXISTING KIDNEY TABLE (needs assembler action). (1) OLG017 tofersen stores 'CAGGATACATTTCTACAGCU'; three independent documents fetched here (INN List 81, the QALSODY FDA label, and US10385341) all give a thymine at position 20. (2) OLG017 also stores backbone_chemistry=full_PS and ps_count=19, but the QALSODY label states explicitly that 15 of the 19 linkages are phosphorothioate and 4 are phosphate diesters - it is PS_PO_mix with ps_count 15. (3) The existing rows are internally inconsistent about the letter convention: OLG001 inotersen writes every thymine as T while OLG018 eplontersen writes the MOE ones as U, even though the two molecules have the identical nucleobase sequence. This lane uses the OLG001 convention throughout. (4) OLG018 eplontersen's ps_count, currently TBD, is 13.

DOCUMENTS FETCHED THIS SESSION: WHO INN Recommended Lists 70-95 and Proposed Lists 108-135 (PDF, cdn.who.int); DailyMed SPLs for SPINRAZA (dd70cd5f-b0fc-4ba4-a5ea-89a34778bd94) and WAINUA (d7dcb847-71dd-4fff-82d0-d43a465fc096); ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 records for NCT04856982, NCT02623699, NCT03761849, NCT05686551, NCT03842969, NCT03342053, NCT04849741, NCT07487389, NCT04740476, NCT06872125, NCT04768972, NCT05231785, NCT06393712, NCT07636811, NCT05399888, NCT06454721, NCT07019922, NCT05127226, NCT06914609, NCT03976349, NCT04494256, NCT04288856, NCT03626012, NCT03225833, NCT04617847, NCT03225846, NCT04617860, NCT05032196, NCT07215416; PMC6961983 (milasen, NEJM) and PMC11255113 (Wave stereopure HTT ASOs, full text XML); the local QALSODY label copy and the local patent set in sources/cns/fpo/.

FETCH FAILURES: milasen supplementary information (HTTP 404 at both europepmc.org and pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov); Europe PMC fullTextXML for PMC6961983 (HTTP 404 - the article was read through the PMC web page instead). The three patent PDFs already in sources/cns/ (US9605263, US10138482, US10815483) are image-only with no text layer and yielded nothing; their HTML equivalents in sources/cns/fpo/ were used instead.

COVERAGE: 10 sequences derived (9 requested + elsunersen as a bonus), 9 left TBD. Every TBD is explained per row. The TBD rows still carry sponsor, phase, indication and trial identifiers read from ClinicalTrials.gov, so they remain useful as identity rows; fields marked 'treat as unverified' in their notes are ones taken from the task brief or search summaries rather than a fetched primary document, and should be confirmed before release.

REMAINING ACTIONABLE ROUTE for the 9 TBDs: Ionis/Biogen and Wave patent sequence listings. This requires a patent that explicitly maps the development code (BIIB078, ION582, ...) to a SEQ ID; the tofersen case here shows the pattern works when such a statement exists (US10385341 names ISIS 666853 and gives SEQ ID NO: 725), but none of the 12 locally available patents names any of the 9 outstanding compounds.
